name: Absence of buoyancy analysis
description: Assess whether buoyancy-driven upward convection is absent or reduced; distinguish observations from assumptions.
prerequisites: Gravity metadata or spatial/flow evidence; ordinary flame photos alone cannot prove zero buoyancy.

name: Molecular-diffusion-dominated transport
description: Interpret transport patterns consistent with molecular diffusion rather than buoyant convection.
prerequisites: Suitable flow/species measurements or experiment documentation.

name: Thermocapillary (Marangoni) flow analysis
description: Assess thermocapillary-flow evidence and its role in microgravity transport.
prerequisites: Velocity/temperature/surface-tension-relevant measurements; cannot be established from a still RGB image.

name: Spherical flame symmetry
description: Evaluate spherical versus buoyancy-shaped flame geometry.
prerequisites: Segmentable flame image or video; report segmentation limitations.

name: Cool-flame combustion interpretation
description: Assess low-temperature combustion and invisible/weakly visible flame phases.
prerequisites: Thermal or chemical evidence preferred; visible RGB imagery alone is insufficient.

name: Schlieren imaging analysis
description: Interpret refractive-index/density-gradient structures in Schlieren imagery.
prerequisites: Schlieren optical setup or labeled source metadata; do not treat ordinary imagery as Schlieren.

name: Shadowgraph imaging analysis
description: Interpret density-gradient and thermal-disturbance patterns in Shadowgraph imagery.
prerequisites: Shadowgraph setup/source metadata is required for a definitive method label.

name: Reflection symmetry scoring (IoU)
description: Mirror a binary flame mask across a selected axis and calculate intersection-over-union.
prerequisites: A flame mask and stated axis; values depend on segmentation quality.

name: Bilateral left-right symmetry scoring
description: Quantify left-right reflection symmetry of a flame mask.
prerequisites: A flame mask and axis estimate.

name: Top-bottom symmetry scoring
description: Quantify top-bottom symmetry to distinguish spherical and buoyancy-shaped forms.
prerequisites: A flame mask and orientation metadata.

name: Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV)
description: Estimate flow vectors from paired images of seeded tracer particles.
prerequisites: Paired seeded-particle images, frame interval, scale calibration and suitable optical access. Without these, mark unavailable; optical flow is not PIV.

name: Flow-field and velocity-vector analysis
description: Analyze provided velocity fields/vectors or appropriately calibrated flow measurements.
prerequisites: Calibrated vector/velocity data; do not infer absolute velocity from uncalibrated pixels.

name: Infrared thermography
description: Analyze thermal images or radiometric temperature measurements.
prerequisites: Radiometric data or calibrated temperature scale. False-color screenshots do not provide absolute temperature unless scale/calibration is known.

name: FLIR thermal-data analysis
description: Interpret thermal imagery from FLIR or equivalent thermal cameras.
prerequisites: Camera/radiometric calibration and emissivity metadata for quantitative temperature claims.

name: Laser-Induced Fluorescence (LIF)
description: Analyze LIF spectra or images for species/temperature-related signals.
prerequisites: Excitation wavelength, calibration and spectral reference data for species assignments.

name: Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy
description: Analyze FTIR spectra and identify candidate absorption bands.
prerequisites: Wavenumber axis, background/reference spectrum and calibration for quantitative/species claims.

name: Formaldehyde / HO₂ signature review
description: Review evidence for formaldehyde and HO₂ signatures in low-temperature combustion phases.
prerequisites: Species-calibrated spectra or cited assignments; do not infer species from unlabeled peaks.

name: Cool-flame extinction and reignition detection
description: Track extinction followed by weak/invisible low-temperature reignition across time.
prerequisites: Time-aligned optical/thermal/spectral signals; RGB disappearance alone cannot prove extinction.

name: Temporal dynamics analysis
description: Analyze time-varying geometry, area, intensity, centroid and signal changes.
prerequisites: Time stamps or known frame interval for rates/frequencies.

name: Symmetry variance per second
description: Quantify temporal variation in symmetry scores.
prerequisites: Frame sequence and time base.

name: Centroid jitter tracking
description: Measure frame-to-frame centroid displacement/instability.
prerequisites: Segmented object over at least two frames; absolute units require spatial calibration.

name: Drop-tower experiment context
description: Classify and compare drop-tower experiments and their short microgravity windows.
prerequisites: Platform/source metadata or database record; do not infer platform solely from flame appearance.

name: Parabolic-flight experiment context
description: Compare parabolic-flight data and transient gravity intervals.
prerequisites: Flight/experiment metadata and gravity-time profile.

name: Sounding-rocket experiment context
description: Identify and compare sounding-rocket combustion experiments.
prerequisites: Payload/mission metadata or database record.

name: ISS / Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) context
description: Match and interpret ISS/CIR experiment datasets.
prerequisites: ISS/CIR metadata, experiment identifier or database record.

name: Orbital capsule / satellite experiment context
description: Compare orbital capsule and satellite microgravity experiment records.
prerequisites: Vehicle/mission identifiers or database record.

name: Flame-boundary fractal dimension
description: Estimate flame-boundary complexity with a declared box-counting/perimeter method.
prerequisites: Binary boundary with adequate resolution; report estimator and scale limits.

name: Convexity-defect tracking
description: Measure concavities and protrusions relative to the convex hull.
prerequisites: Segmented contour; noise and threshold choice affect defects.

name: Exposure-duration / platform comparison
description: Compare how flame geometry evolves across platform microgravity durations.
prerequisites: Comparable time axes, gravity histories and experimental conditions.

name: Flame segmentation and mask extraction
description: Separate candidate flame regions from the background for downstream geometry analysis.
prerequisites: Image quality and lighting affect segmentation; manual correction may be required.

name: Rotational symmetry analysis
description: Compare rotated masks around a defined center at specified angles.
prerequisites: Segmented mask and center estimate; angle/order must be stated.

name: Convex-hull / convexity analysis
description: Calculate convex hull, solidity and related shape descriptors.
prerequisites: Segmented contour.

name: Boundary roughness analysis
description: Quantify flame-edge irregularity using perimeter, area and contour statistics.
prerequisites: Consistent segmentation and image resolution.

name: Perimeter-to-area ratio
description: Calculate normalized boundary complexity descriptors.
prerequisites: Segmented mask; scale/normalization convention must be reported.

name: Flame peak / edge detection
description: Detect edge protrusions and peaks along flame boundaries.
prerequisites: Segmented contour; peak count depends on smoothing and thresholds.

name: Geometric centroid vs. center-of-mass comparison
description: Compare bounding/geometric center and pixel-intensity or mass-weighted center proxies.
prerequisites: Image mask and clear definition of the mass/intensity proxy; pixels are not physical mass.

name: Fire vs. rigid glowing-object classification
description: Use temporal/geometric evidence to distinguish flame-like behavior from static glowing objects.
prerequisites: Temporal evidence improves confidence; a single still is insufficient for reliable classification.

name: Flicker-frequency analysis
description: Estimate periodic intensity/area variation from a time series.
prerequisites: Known frame rate/time base and sufficient sampling duration.

name: Differentiable symmetry loss / MSE
description: Define reflection-based losses for training/evaluating segmentation or classification networks.
prerequisites: Labeled ground truth and a training/evaluation workflow; this is not run on a single sample as a trained model.

name: CNN / ResNet classification
description: Apply a trained, validated image classifier to labeled fire imagery.
prerequisites: A trained model and representative labeled evaluation data; no pretrained NASA-specific classifier is bundled.

name: Temperature distribution analysis
description: Summarize calibrated temperatures and spatial/temporal distributions.
prerequisites: Temperature units, sensor calibration and acquisition metadata.

name: Chemical species concentration analysis
description: Analyze provided calibrated species concentrations.
prerequisites: Species labels, calibration curves and units.

name: Gas-flow velocity and direction analysis
description: Analyze calibrated flow velocity vectors and directions.
prerequisites: Spatial and temporal calibration; PIV prerequisites where applicable.

name: Heat-radiation analysis
description: Interpret calibrated radiative/thermal measurements.
prerequisites: Sensor calibration, emissivity assumptions and units.

name: Soot-formation analysis
description: Review soot-related imaging or measured soot/particulate quantities.
prerequisites: Optical calibration or direct particulate/chemical measurements.

name: Raman spectroscopy analysis
description: Review Raman spectral peaks and candidate vibrational bands.
prerequisites: Wavenumber calibration, baseline correction and reference library for species assignment.

name: ML-based spectral deconvolution
description: Separate overlapping spectral contributions using a documented/reference-backed method.
prerequisites: Raw spectra, instrument response and validated reference components; do not fabricate species.

name: CO concentration / signature analysis
description: Assess carbon-monoxide data or calibrated spectral signatures.
prerequisites: Calibrated CO measurement or validated spectral assignment.

name: Soot-precursor identification
description: Review documented or calibrated soot-precursor measurements.
prerequisites: Chemical reference spectra or instrument-validated species concentrations.

name: Chemical reaction / kinetics interpretation
description: Interpret time-resolved species and temperature measurements against documented reaction mechanisms.
prerequisites: Species, rates, conditions and a specified mechanism/model; an LLM summary is not a kinetics solver.

name: Gravity-scaling interpolation
description: Compare or interpolate measured trends across gravity levels when supported by data.
prerequisites: Measured data spanning gravity conditions; extrapolation must be labeled and uncertainty shown.

name: Lunar-gravity (0.17g) comparison
description: Compare measured or validated modeled fire behavior at lunar gravity.
prerequisites: Relevant lunar-gravity data or validated physical model.

name: Martian-gravity (0.38g) comparison
description: Compare measured or validated modeled fire behavior at Martian gravity.
prerequisites: Relevant Martian-gravity data or validated physical model.

name: Cross-experiment comparison
description: Compare evidence across experiments while accounting for differing conditions and measurement methods.
prerequisites: Comparable metadata and units; explain any non-comparability.

name: Evidence-backed finding ranking
description: Rank findings based on measured evidence, relevance, uncertainty and data quality.
prerequisites: Expose scoring factors; never rank unsupported speculation as confirmed.

name: Geometric / thermal / chemical anomaly identification
description: Flag deviations from comparable baselines and identify the supporting measurements.
prerequisites: A baseline/reference or explicit threshold is required for statistical anomaly claims.

name: Fire-instability and mission-safety interpretation
description: Translate findings into cautious, traceable fire-safety implications for exploration environments.
prerequisites: Decision-support only; not flight certification or operational fire-safety approval.

name: Terrestrial (1g) vs. microgravity (0g) combustion differentiation
description: Differentiate 1g buoyancy-dominated teardrop plumes from 0g diffusion-dominated spherical flames using vertical symmetry delta, aspect ratio, and soot shell distribution.
prerequisites: Segmented flame geometry or multi-gravity experimental measurements.

name: 0g, 1g, and partial-gravity flame behavior differentiation
description: Compare flame envelope elongation, buoyant velocity scaling, and limiting oxygen shifts across 0g, Lunar (0.16g), Martian (0.38g), and 1g regimes.
prerequisites: Gravity metadata and geometry or burn-rate measurements.

name: Spherical vs. teardrop flame classification
description: Classify segmented flame masks into spherical (0g diffusion), ellipsoidal (partial-g/forced-flow), or teardrop (buoyant plume) regimes using aspect ratio, circularity, and top-bottom IoU.
prerequisites: Segmented foreground flame contour.

name: Frame-by-frame flame symmetry tracking
description: Track bilateral and top-bottom reflection symmetry IoU across sequential frames or multi-specimen image sets to detect oscillatory instability or buoyant transition.
prerequisites: Multi-frame video or multi-image sequence.

name: OpenCV computer-vision feature pipeline
description: Execute HSV warm-mask segmentation, morphological cleanup, contour extraction, moments calculation, and reflection/rotation IoU scoring.
prerequisites: Decodable RGB, grayscale, or thermal image/video frame.

name: Archival ISS/CIR and drop-tower video analysis
description: Extract multi-frame area evolution, centroid drift, and symmetry decay from archival ISS/CIR or drop-tower combustion video sequences.
prerequisites: Video stream or multi-frame archival imagery with platform context.

name: Spectral data re-analysis
description: Re-analyze uploaded emission/absorption tables for candidate radical bands (OH* ~308 nm, CH* ~431 nm, C2* ~516 nm) and continuum thermal emission.
prerequisites: Wavelength or wavenumber spectral table.

name: Low-temperature radical detection
description: Assess blue chemiluminescent intensity ratios and UV/IR spectral peaks associated with low-temperature alkylperoxy/formaldehyde radical pathways.
prerequisites: Spectral trace or blue-to-red chemiluminescence ratio proxy.

name: Low-temperature combustion signature extraction
description: Extract weak-luminosity, high blue-to-red ratio, and soot-free spherical signatures characteristic of 500–800 K cool flames.
prerequisites: Color/thermal imagery or spectral/temperature measurements.

name: Cross-platform flame behavior comparison
description: Differentiate flame steadiness and residual g-jitter effects across Drop Tower (2–10 s), Parabolic Flight (20–25 s), Sounding Rocket (3–15 min), and ISS/CIR.
prerequisites: Platform metadata or catalogue experiment records.

name: Transient vs. stable flame geometry differentiation
description: Distinguish quasi-steady diffusion envelopes from transient ignition/extinction or g-jitter-perturbed flame shapes using boundary roughness and area variance.
prerequisites: Segmented contour or temporal area/symmetry series.

name: Static vs. dynamic shape differentiation
description: Differentiate static rigid glowing emitters from dynamic deforming flame fronts using contour complexity, convexity defects, and intensity-centroid offset.
prerequisites: Segmented contour mask and intensity distribution.

name: Spherical, calm, turbulent, and irregular flame classification
description: Classify flames into spherical_0g, calm_laminar, transitional_oscillating, or turbulent_irregular using circularity, fractal dimension, and peak count.
prerequisites: Segmented flame contour and boundary descriptors.

name: JSON-based geometric feature extraction & classification
description: Serialize normalized geometric feature vectors and classification labels (spherical_diffusion, turbulent_fire, glowing_object) into structured JSON for sorting and comparison.
prerequisites: Extracted image, video, or JSON descriptor payload.

name: Dominant flame orientation (degrees) analysis
description: Compute minimum-area bounding-box orientation angle (degrees) and elongation axis to identify buoyant plume alignment or forced-flow direction.
prerequisites: Segmented flame contour.

name: Numerical comparison across experimental conditions
description: Quantify numerical deltas (Δsymmetry, Δcircularity, Δfractal_dimension, Δsoot_index) between uploaded specimens and reference NASA PSI conditions.
prerequisites: Extracted numerical descriptors and reference dataset.

name: Combustion and extinction chemical signature differentiation
description: Evaluate CO/CO2 ratios, radiative loss indicators, and radical emission drop-offs associated with radiative or diffusive flame extinction.
prerequisites: Spectral/gas telemetry or colour-channel radiative proxy.

name: Flame symmetry variation across gravity levels
description: Track how top-bottom reflection symmetry IoU and aspect ratio degrade progressively from 0g (~0.95) to Lunar 0.16g (~0.74), Martian 0.38g (~0.56), and Earth 1g (~0.42).
prerequisites: Extracted symmetry descriptors or gravity-indexed dataset.

name: Cool-flame invisible reignition risk identification
description: Identify post-extinction low-temperature cool-flame hazard where invisible CH2O/HO2 chemistry can trigger secondary hot reignition in spacecraft enclosures.
prerequisites: Fuel type (e.g., alkanes/heptane/decane), spectral/color ratios, or thermal traces.

name: Predictive fire safety analysis for Lunar and Martian missions
description: Synthesize buoyant velocity scaling (v_b ∝ √g), Minimum Oxygen Concentration (MOC) shifts, and suppression protocols for Lunar (0.16g) and Martian (0.38g) habitats.
prerequisites: Extracted flame descriptors and mission atmosphere parameters.
